assessments.statement: solver.terminal_horizon_truncation: The adopted change was a weight only; per-update effective_horizon was not read in this context, so this hypothesis is neither supported nor refuted by the new evidence.

controller.budget_truncated_plan_selection: Both runs record deadline_misses = 35 against the 0.01 s control period while the candidate averages 17.77877309145406 s per complete update, so plan selection plausibly occurs under a saturated solve budget; the paired weight change does not certify this as the cause.
supporting_relevance: Nearly every update stops by User_Requested_Stop (F507 = 34) rather than convergence (Solve_Succeeded F466 = 1; Maximum_Iterations_Exceeded F528 = 1), while mean complete-update time F458 = 17.77877309145406 s dwarfs the 0.01 s control period F521 = 0.01 s, so plan selection plausibly runs out of its allotted solve budget at most updates.
